mechanism: Amikacin (aminoglycoside) increases risk of ototoxicity and nephrotoxicity which can be potentiated by haloperidol's CNS effects and potential renal impairment; additive neurotoxic effects possible.
action: Monitor renal function, auditory function, and vestibular symptoms closely; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antibiotics if possible; use lowest effective haloperidol dose.
